title: V2's Overview tab: five ways to make it answer again
brief: Zach picked V2 (the stock workbench, the target view as its own page) and asked: “improve the overview tab on the dataset view It was better in the past … show 5 proposals here … Probably shwoing a model x dataset or something seems reasonable here as one example”. V2's Overview lost Nov 23's answer sentence, League table, matrix and per-config colour to a 23-dot log plot and a 36-entry dataset legend (CONTRACT.md has the diagnosis). Each proposal below is V2 with only the Overview changed, live over the 18,507 real runs of all four deployments; every number recounts with the rail and matches a Python oracle before and after ticking the UR5e cell.
defaultWhy: O3 Headline tiles → drill, 91/100: the first screen is six calm answers (best config with its gap, speed growth, the energy frontier, model × dataset coverage, the worst target, runs left), and every one of Nov 23's elements plus Zach's model × dataset matrix is one click away on its own page (§55, stock). O1 The League, back, 86: Nov 23 exactly (it reproduces Nov 23's numbers after the tick), but the matrix sits a screen down and unfiltered the page is long. O2 76, O5 63, O4 60.
decisionHinge: Whether the detail must be ON the Overview or may be one click away. Require it on the page (FR2 and FR3 count only what the Overview shows) and O3 drops to 79 while O1 stays 86 and leads. A natural splice either way: O3's tiles as the Overview's first row over O1's League, with O2's matrix as the League's matrix (nested by model type, columns switchable).
invariants: V2 unchanged but for its Overview: the rail, Targets, Runs, the target view (keep= + back=) and Open in Rerun.
18,507 real runs of all four deployments (UR5e cell 5,750 · UR5e alone 3 · BAM FB 4,972 · pendulum 7,782); model type is V2's PROPOSED mapping, labelled.

One aggregation for every figure (kit/model.js): a target's value = the median over its runs, a group's = the median over its targets, at the fastest speed the filter leaves; oracle.py recomputes each stated number in Python.
Stock data-ui <data-workbench> (main 1f7c004); what it cannot draw is a host view registered through data-ui's own registerView, inside its panel.
boundary: Live prototypes served by one local command over the real rows; the oracle match, the tick, each variant's switch and drill, and V2's target link were exercised headless at 1440 × 900. Not wired into traj_compare's dataset.py; no data-ui change (8 gaps named in kit/GAPS.md).

variants.name: The League, back, over the rail
variants.thesis: Nov 23's Overview recomputed over whatever the rail leaves: one answer sentence, the League table (every KPI at the fastest speed with its shape over speed, best-in counts, a worst-targets drill), then the config × dataset · split matrix whose column click re-ranks the table.
variants.bestWhen: You want the page you liked back: after the UR5e-cell tick it reproduces Nov 23's numbers exactly (0.0366 mm; 1.01×, 1.2×, 27×, 1,996×; best in 20 of 22, 4 of 44, 16 of 22, 4 of 44, 0 of 22).
variants.losesWhen: Nothing is filtered: 23 configs, a 50-value dataset · split select and a 50-column matrix a screen down that scrolls sideways; no model-type grouping.

variants.name: Model × dataset matrix first
variants.thesis: The Overview is one grid: model type (proposed) › config down, deployment › dataset across, median tool RMS per cell, each column's best ringed and read off a roll-up row; the columns switch to split, speed or deployment and model types fold.
variants.bestWhen: The question is where each model type and config wins, and where it has never run — Zach's own model × dataset example, shaped like data-ui §56's nested matrix.
variants.losesWhen: You want energy, jerk, stop error or best-in counts: the cells hold tool RMS only; unfiltered it is 34 dataset columns wide and its answer leads with a BAM FB config that wins many BAM FB columns.

variants.name: Headline tiles → drill
variants.thesis: Six calm headline tiles, each a small view whose title row and Open chip go to its full page (data-ui §55's Overview grid): best config, speed growth, energy frontier, model × dataset coverage, worst target, runs left.
variants.bestWhen: You check in often: the state in one glance, then one click into the question you have (the League, the model × dataset matrix, the speed sweep, the trade-off, the worst targets).
variants.losesWhen: You want two questions side by side: each detail is its own tab (eight tabs now), and the Overview shows only the top five configs.

variants.name: Trade-off map
variants.thesis: Each config is one point, accuracy (tool RMS, log) against a cost (energy per task, or jerk, or stop error), one panel per deployment, the Pareto frontier drawn and named: which config is best and what it costs.
variants.bestWhen: Two configs are close on accuracy and you need the tiebreaker (UR5e cell: ctc_tuned_v2 0.0366 mm at 42.9 J against id_pd 0.043 mm at 22.8 J).
variants.losesWhen: You need where (dataset) or at what speed a config wins; configs without the cost tag leave their panel (UR5e alone; most of BAM FB's).
